narrative.overview: Vireal presents AI video effects as a compact cinematic catalogue used primarily on a phone in low ambient light. The interface stays near-black so numbered covers and real preview media carry the emotion, while mist-cyan controls make state and action legible without turning the screen into a neon dashboard. The system is operational beneath the atmosphere: upload requirements, duration, price, balance, quota, and task state are always explicit backend truth.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black field with one cool mist accent.
Media or intentional numbered fallback leads each public screen.
Compact mobile hierarchy with 44px minimum interactive targets.
Data-driven quantity, pricing, availability, and state.
Inline SVG icons with a consistent light stroke.

rules.name: The Truth Accent Rule
rules.body: Mist cyan highlights an actionable or truthful current state; it is not scattered as decoration.

rules.name: The Compact Copy Rule
rules.body: Small type is limited to short labels and secondary facts; instructions and errors must remain readable without relying on capitalization or tracking.

rules.name: The Tonal-First Rule
rules.body: Use background value and a quiet border before adding a shadow.

dos: Do preserve the external prototype as the visual authority for the H5 catalogue and generation screens.
Do render every catalogue quantity and order from backend data.
Do show current cost, balance, quota, available duration, and task state from API responses.
Do fall back from preview video to cover and then to the numbered gradient treatment.
Do keep public interactions at least 44px high and keep keyboard focus visible.
donts: Don't hard-code three visible effects; three is only the new-category seed count.
Don't expose model prompts, storage keys, or internal provider secrets to the H5.
Don't place Wallet or Coins in bottom navigation.
Don't invent static prices, balances, quotas, or durations in production.
Don't turn prototype-specific metadata labels, brand glow, or the text coin mark into general-purpose design-system decoration.
